title: Diagnostic Instrumentation Library — α_t tracking, KL divergence, null-space estimation (cross-cutting infrastructure)
summary: python/carnot/eval/diagnostics.py shipped with 4 instrumentation classes + 1 test-verifier helper. Each class is the canonical implementation referenced by the 4 phase-validation experiments downstream (exp1092 Phase-1a, exp1093 Phase-1c, exp1094 Phase-2a, exp1095 Phase-3a) and by the FR-11 self-distillation loop's α_t convergence guarantee.

AlphaT.purpose: Zenil exogenous-grounding fraction tracker — records (n_verified, n_self) per training step and computes verified/total ratio. The Zenil Theorem 5 condition `inf_t alpha_t > 0` is the load-bearing convergence guarantee for FR-11 self-distillation.

KLDivergenceEstimator.purpose: Plug-in KL(P || Q) estimator with Laplace smoothing; used by Phase-2a sampler-correctness audits to compare an FPGA Glauber sampler's empirical distribution against the correct CPU Gibbs reference.

NullSpaceEstimator.purpose: Joint kernel of k verifiers' kernels — joint-null-space dimension estimator plus r-correlation pairwise diversity metric from arXiv 2604.12086. Phase-1c audits use this to verify the ensemble's joint null space stays below 5% of input space.
NullSpaceEstimator.smoke_test: make_test_verifiers(n=3) produces 3 callable verifiers with correct output shape OK

DecodedTextDiversity.purpose: Token-entropy diversity score that flags degenerate decoder collapse (decoder ignoring its bottleneck and reverting to language-model prior). Phase-3a DBAE-EBM adversarial audits depend on this to detect identity-decoder pathology.

make_test_verifiers.purpose: Helper that builds n synthetic verifier callables with non-overlapping kernels — used in unit tests of NullSpaceEstimator to assert joint-null-space fraction stays low on a well-behaved ensemble.
make_test_verifiers.smoke_test: make_test_verifiers(n=3) returns list of Callable, output shape (100,) for X.shape=(100,8) OK

prior_failures.actual_scope: LLM-output extractor recall — does the extractor catch numeric answers in model responses?
prior_failures.exp1090_scope: alpha_t / KL / null-space measurement instrumentation library

downstream_consumers: exp1092 Phase-1a Adversarial Verifier Robustness Audit (uses NullSpaceEstimator + DecodedTextDiversity)
exp1093 Phase-1c Verifier Joint Null-Space Measurement (uses NullSpaceEstimator)
exp1094 Phase-2a Sampler Correctness Audit (uses KLDivergenceEstimator)
exp1095 Phase-3a DBAE-EBM Adversarial Round (uses AlphaT + DecodedTextDiversity)
FR-11 Self-Distillation Loop (uses AlphaT for inf_t alpha_t > 0 monitoring)
